label: normal_billing_and_access
subject: Double charge + dashboard inactive
body: Hi, I was charged twice for my Pro subscription last month. My analytics dashboard also shows 'subscription inactive' even though my account page says active. I need a refund and dashboard access restored ASAP.

label: critical_security_incident
subject: Account compromised - urgent
body: I think my account was hacked. Someone changed my payment method and exported all my data without my authorization. This is extremely urgent. I may need to involve my attorney.

label: simple_password_reset
subject: Can't reset my password
body: The password reset link I received isn't working. It says 'link expired' but I clicked it within 5 minutes of receiving it. Please help.

label: api_rate_limit_technical
subject: Getting 429 errors from your API
body: Our integration keeps hitting 429 rate limit errors even though we're on the Pro plan. We're sending about 500 requests per minute. Is this expected? We need to scale up urgently.

label: multi_domain_complex
subject: Billing, access, and API all broken after upgrade
body: After upgrading to Enterprise yesterday: (1) I was charged for both Pro and Enterprise in the same billing cycle, (2) my team can't access the dashboard, and (3) our API keys stopped working. Three separate issues, all urgent.
